note:
Committed by `pnpm run audit:update`. See tooling/audit-gate.mjs.

`GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm` (CVE-2026-93687, braces <= 3.0.3, high) was baselined 2026-10-05 on purpose and cannot be upgraded away:

- **No patched version exists.** The advisory lists patched versions: None, and the affected range is <= 3.0.3, which is the version already resolved here. There is no version to move to, so `pnpm update` cannot clear it and the gate would stay red indefinitely.
- **Not runtime-reachable.** braces arrives only through build-time tooling: micromatch 4.0.8 -> jest-message-util, jscodeshift, metro-file-map, fast-glob. Nothing in a served request path imports it.
- **Low practical risk.** The defect is stack exhaustion from a deeply-nested glob pattern supplied by an attacker (CWE-674, uncontrolled recursion). Exploiting it requires the attacker to control a glob pattern that this project does not accept from untrusted input. CVSS 8.7, EPSS 0.74%.

Baselining keeps the advisory visible and tracked: it is counted, it is reported by `pnpm run audit`, and the gate still fails on anything new or anything escalated. Revisit when upstream publishes a fixed braces release -- at that point remove this note and the entry together, and the gate will hold the improvement without a code change. Suppressing it silently instead would have been the failure mode this file was written to avoid.
